# How to Download TikTok Videos on PC: Step-by-Step Tutorial

TikTok is one of the most popular platforms for watching short videos, but you don't always need to watch them on your phone. Many users also prefer watching TikTok videos on their laptops and desktop computers.

Sometimes, you may come across a video that you want to save on your computer. It could be a useful tutorial that you'd like to watch again or a video that you have permission to download.

If you're wondering how to download TikTok videos on PC, the process can be quite simple when you use a browser-based downloader.

With TikSaveMP4, you can download supported public TikTok videos in MP4 format directly through your computer's browser. There's no need to install dedicated downloading software or register for an account.

This tutorial will walk you through how to download TikTok videos on Windows PCs, laptops, and Mac computers.

## Is It Possible to Download TikTok Videos on Your Computer?

Yes. It is possible to download TikTok videos to your computer if the video is publicly accessible and an appropriate download method is available.

You can use TikTok's built-in download feature when the creator and platform permit it. Another option is a compatible online TikTok video downloader.

With TikSaveMP4, you can submit a supported public TikTok video URL and select from the available MP4 download formats.

After downloading, you can store the file on your computer and play it using a compatible media player.

Keep in mind that not all TikTok videos offer the same download options or video quality.

## How to Download TikTok Videos on PC Using TikSaveMP4

Follow these steps to save TikTok videos to your computer using TikSaveMP4.

### Step 1: Open TikTok on Your PC

Open a web browser such as Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Firefox, or Safari.

Visit TikTok and find the public video you want to download.

You can either access TikTok through your browser or copy a video link from the TikTok mobile app.

Make sure the video is publicly accessible.

### Step 2: Copy the TikTok Video Link

Open the TikTok video.

Select the Share option and choose Copy link, if available.

Alternatively, copy the video URL from your browser's address bar if you're viewing the individual video page.

Make sure you've copied the correct link.

### Step 3: Visit the TikSaveMP4 Website

Open a new browser tab and visit [TikSaveMP4](https://tiksavemp4.online/).

You'll see an input field where you can paste your copied TikTok video URL.

Since TikSaveMP4 works through your browser, there's no need to install additional software.

### Step 4: Paste the Video URL

Paste the TikTok video link into the input field and click the submit button.

Wait while TikSaveMP4 analyzes the public post.

If the video is supported, the available download formats and quality options will appear.

### Step 5: Select MP4 and Download

Choose one of the available MP4 download options.

If multiple quality options are offered, select the one that best suits your needs.

The quality of the downloaded video depends on the original source and cannot be improved by the downloader.

Start downloading the video and wait for the file to be saved to your computer.

## Where Are Downloaded TikTok Videos Saved on PC?

After using an online TikTok video downloader for PC, the downloaded MP4 file usually appears in your browser's default download location.

On Windows computers, downloaded files are commonly saved in the Downloads folder.

A typical location is:

`C:\Users\YourUsername\Downloads`

On macOS, downloaded videos are also commonly saved in the Downloads folder.

However, the exact location depends on your browser settings.

If you cannot find the downloaded video, check your browser's download history.

In Chrome, Edge, and Firefox on Windows, pressing Ctrl + J usually opens the downloads list.

From there, you can locate the downloaded file or open its containing folder.

## How to Download TikTok Videos on Windows 10 and Windows 11

The downloading process is almost the same on Windows 10 and Windows 11.

All you need is a compatible browser to access TikTok, copy a supported public video link, and paste it into TikSaveMP4.

When the available MP4 formats appear, choose one and save the file.

You can then watch the downloaded video using a compatible media player.

For example, Windows Media Player and VLC can play many MP4 files.

You don't need to install a dedicated TikTok video downloader for PC to use the TikSaveMP4 website.

## How to Download TikTok Videos on Mac

A similar process works for Mac users.

Open Safari, Chrome, or another compatible browser.

Find a public TikTok video and copy its URL.

Visit TikSaveMP4, paste the link, and select an available MP4 download option.

Your browser may save the video automatically or ask where you'd like to store it.

You can then play the downloaded video using compatible software, such as QuickTime Player, when its codecs are supported.

The main difference between Windows and macOS is how the browser handles downloads and how the operating system opens saved files.

## Can You Download TikTok Videos Without a Watermark on PC?

Some TikTok video sources may allow videos to be downloaded without a visible watermark.

However, watermark-free downloads are not guaranteed for every TikTok post.

The result depends on the original video and the formats available to the downloader.

TikSaveMP4 cannot guarantee that every downloaded video will be free of watermarks.

Additionally, downloading a video doesn't automatically give you permission to publish, distribute, or commercially reuse it.

Always respect the original creator's rights.

## Why Can't I Download TikTok Videos on My PC?

Sometimes, downloading a TikTok video may fail, or the video may not be available in your preferred format.

Here are some common reasons.

### The TikTok Video Is Private

TikSaveMP4 works with supported public TikTok videos.

Private, login-restricted, or otherwise inaccessible videos are not supported.

### The Video URL Is Incorrect

Make sure you've copied the complete TikTok video URL.

An incorrect or unsupported URL may prevent the downloader from identifying the video.

### The Video Has Been Deleted

If the creator has deleted the video or it is no longer publicly available, the downloader may not be able to retrieve it.

### Temporary Download Problems

Service restrictions, upstream changes, or temporary server problems can sometimes interrupt downloads.

If this happens, wait a while and try again with a supported public video.

### Browser Download Restrictions

Your browser may require permission before saving a downloaded file or may ask you to select a download location.

Check your browser's download settings and any displayed warnings.

Avoid bypassing browser security warnings for files you don't trust.
